title: A path from Spore to Seed
summary:
Spore-to-Seed eligibility got a daily check, and the learn catalog gained a study companion.

A daily eligibility check was added for automatic Seed upgrades. Spore users who reach 8 Dev Points through GitHub account age, commits, public repositories, and stars qualify; Enter now explains the scoring rules.

The learn app catalog added Study Buzz, a community-made app with quizzes, flashcards, study guides, AI help, and a little XP for motivation.
